sentences.japanese: 傘を持っていった方がいいよ。
sentences.english: You had better take an umbrella with you.

sentences.japanese: 君の傘をバスの中に忘れてきてしまった。
sentences.english: I left your umbrella in the bus.

sentences.japanese: 間違えてお前の傘を持ってっちゃったんだ。
sentences.english: I took your umbrella by mistake.

sentences.japanese: 君が傘を持って行ったのは賢明だった。
sentences.english: It was wise of you to take your umbrella with you.

sentences.japanese: 銀行と言うのはお天気の日に傘を貸したがるが、雨の日には、人を見捨てようとするところだ。
sentences.english: Banks will try to lend you an umbrella on a sunny day, but they will turn their backs on a rainy day.
